limitations_and_boundaries: The atlas uses cancer cell lines and pharmacological compounds, but is designed as a broadly applicable perturbation atlas.
Drug treatment and dose have modest global transcriptomic effects relative to cell line identity and cell cycle phase.
Cell cycle phase distribution data for specific drugs (e.g., Carbamazepine showing little G2/M enrichment) are observed but not mechanistically explained in the extracted chunks.

research_questions.statement: How do diverse small-molecule perturbations impact transcriptomic profiles across multiple cancer cell lines at single-cell resolution?

provenance.text_excerpt: these results suggest that cell line identity, followed by cell cycle phase, are the most major factors in driving stratification of the data. And as expected, drug treatment and dose have a more modest effect relative to these factors

claims.statement: Cell line identity, followed by cell cycle phase, are the major drivers of transcriptomic variation in Tahoe-100M, while drug treatment has modest global effects.

provenance.text_excerpt: treatment with RMC-6236, a pan-RAS inhibitor, produced the greatest effect in the KRAS-mutated group, with the most substantial difference in Vision scores observed at the lowest (p = 0.065, Welch’s t-test) and intermediate (p = 0.063, Welch’s t-test) doses compared to the unmutated RAS group. These results underscore the KRAS-specific action of RMC-6236

claims.statement: RMC-6236 shows greatest effect in KRAS-mutated cell lines, supporting its KRAS-specific action.

provenance.text_excerpt: HDAC and microtubule inhibitors induced the greatest G2/M arrest.

claims.statement: HDAC and microtubule inhibitors induce the strongest G2/M phase arrest among drug classes tested.

provenance.text_excerpt: As the largest single-cell dataset to date, Tahoe-100M enables artificial-intelligence (AI)-driven models to learn context-dependent functions, capturing fundamental principles of gene regulation and network dynamics.

claims.statement: Tahoe-100M is the largest single-cell dataset to date, enabling AI models to learn context-dependent gene functions and regulatory dynamics.

provenance.text_excerpt: Treatment with Dabrafenib elicited the most pronounced effect in cell lines harboring BRAF mutations, as evidenced by significantly lower scores at both the lowest (P = 0.0013, Welch’s t-test) and highest (P = 0.00023, Welch’s t-test) doses, whereas KRAS-mutated lines showed minimal change.

claims.statement: Dabrafenib elicits stronger transcriptomic effects in BRAF-mutant cell lines compared to KRAS-mutant lines.

provenance.text_excerpt: Palbociclib and Dinaciclib exhibited distinct enrichments, with Palbociclib showing enrichment in the G1 phase and Dinaciclib in the G2/M phase. This is in contrast to the other CDK inhibitors — Abemaciclib, AT5719, and Ribociclib — which displayed little to no enrichment.

claims.statement: Palbociclib enriches cells in G1 phase, while Dinaciclib enriches cells in G2/M phase, contrasting with other CDK inhibitors.

provenance.text_excerpt: Our high-throughput Mosaic platform, composed of a highly diverse and optimally balanced “cell village”, reduces batch effects and enables parallel profiling of thousands of conditions at single-cell resolution at an unprecedented scale.

claims.statement: The Mosaic platform reduces batch effects by using a diverse and balanced 'cell village' for parallel profiling.

datasets.description: Single-cell transcriptomic atlas of 100 million cells from 50 cancer cell lines treated with over 1,100 small-molecule perturbations.
datasets.name: Tahoe-100M

experiments_or_tasks: Spheroids of 50 cancer cell lines were cultured, treated with drugs including DMSO controls for 24 hours, dissociated, fixed, and profiled using Parse GigaLab kit for scRNA-seq. Cells were assigned to cell lines via SNP-based deconvolution.

methods.name: Mosaic platform
methods.protocol_description: Spheroids of mixed cell lines in suspension were treated with drugs for 24 hours, then dissociated, fixed, and profiled with Parse GigaLab scRNA-seq kit. SNP-based deconvolution was used to assign cell lines. A total of 14 96-well plates were used, each processed into 72-165 sublibraries, producing ~1.4 trillion reads from 153 million cells. Filtering yielded 100.6 million cells passing minimal filters and 95.6 million passing full filters.

study_units.name: Generation of Tahoe-100M Atlas using Mosaic platform
